verses.text: [Our high priest] has been tempted . . . just as we are—yet he did not sin.
verses.title: Compassionate Understanding

verses.text: Praise to God for a Living Hope Praise be to the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ! In his great mercy he has given us new birth into a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,
A new command I give you: Love one another. As I have loved you, so you must love one another.
